title: Microsoft Announces New Business Central + Copilot Bundles Starting January 2027
summary: Microsoft is launching Business Central and Microsoft 365 Copilot bundles starting January 1, 2027, offering cost savings of $6 per user per month. The announcement includes expanded Copilot capabilities such as direct integration into Business Central and a new Edit with Copilot feature that lets users perform supported actions using natural language.
key_points: Two new CSP bundles available January 2027: Essentials at $95/month and Premium at $125/month per user, for customers up to 300 seats
No qualifying Microsoft 365 base subscription required to purchase bundles
Edit with Copilot Early Access Preview launched October 27, 2026, enabling natural language task execution
Copilot integrated directly into Business Central starting with 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) for unified experience
Partners can offer Copilot onboarding, training, and AI agent configuration services to customers

quotes.text: Starting January 1, 2027, two new CSP bundles will be available for customers with up to 300 seats.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the launch date and eligibility scope for the new bundled offering

quotes.text: Users can use natural language to perform supported actions and make changes in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability of Edit with Copilot, moving beyond information retrieval to task execution

quotes.text: Microsoft is clearly moving toward a closer integration of Business Central and Copilot.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the strategic direction and its implications for the platform's evolution
